attributes.name: confluentWireFormat
attributes.description: Frame the payload the Confluent Schema Registry way: magic byte 0, schema id as big-endian int32.

attributes.name: schema
attributes.description: Explicit Avro schema (JSON).

attributes.name: schemaId
attributes.description: Schema id written into the frame when ConfluentWireFormat is on.

attributes.name: delimiter
attributes.description: Field delimiter.

attributes.name: hasHeaderRecord
attributes.description: Whether the first record is a header (written on marshal, read on unmarshal).

attributes.name: newLine
attributes.description: Record terminator written on marshal.

attributes.name: trimFields
attributes.description: Trim whitespace around fields on read.

attributes.name: maxFileNameLength
attributes.description: Longest file name of a part, in characters.

attributes.name: maxPartBytes
attributes.description: Largest decoded part, in bytes.

attributes.name: maxParts
attributes.description: Most parts one body may have.

attributes.name: maxTotalBytes
attributes.description: Largest body, in bytes as it arrives.

attributes.name: multipartWithoutAttachment
attributes.description: Marshal with the mixed subtype writes a multipart even when the message has no attachments (Camel's multipartWithoutAttachment); otherwise such a body is left as it is.

attributes.name: subType
attributes.description: The subtype Marshal writes and the format registers under: form-data (the default: a FormBody body and file attachments) or mixed (the body as the first part, as Camel's mimeMultipart).

attributes.name: confluentWireFormat
attributes.description: Frame the payload the Confluent Schema Registry way: magic byte 0, schema id as big-endian int32, message-index list ([0], the first message of the schema).

attributes.name: schemaId
attributes.description: Schema id written into the frame when ConfluentWireFormat is on.

attributes.name: arrays
attributes.description: The arrays paths, comma-separated: //Item,/Order/Tag (Arrays).

attributes.name: attributePrefix
attributes.description: The attribute prefix (AttributePrefix).

attributes.name: indent
attributes.description: Whether the output is indented (Indent).

attributes.name: namespaces
attributes.description: How names carry their namespaces (Namespaces).

attributes.name: plural
attributes.description: The plural-wrapper rule (Plural).

attributes.name: prefixes
attributes.description: Namespace prefixes, comma-separated prefix=uri pairs: o=urn:orders (Prefixes).

attributes.name: root
attributes.description: The root element of JSON to XML (Root).

attributes.name: schema
attributes.description: The schema path (Schema).

attributes.name: schemaRoot
attributes.description: The directory imports may read from, relative to the schema's directory (SchemaRoot).

attributes.name: textKey
attributes.description: The text key (TextKey).

attributes.name: ignoreUnmatchedProperties
attributes.description: Ignore document keys that have no matching property on unmarshal.
